label: betA
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the betA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor betA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,393 to 3,472 from dnaA. Read in 514 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying betA once); 41,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 80% of genes, 1.06 bits on average (perplexity 2.9 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 8,759 calls, named 94%, 0.38 bits; shell 30,306 calls, named 80%, 1.04 bits; cloud 2,055 calls, named 16%, 4.17 bits. Outside an RGP 10,272 calls, named 92%, 0.44 bits; inside an RGP 30,848 calls, named 75%, 1.26 bits. Columns: 3 spine, 47 fork, 30 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.26 against 0.44 bits) and names fewer genes (75% against 92%); 30,848 of the 41,120 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 29 (pinE, a variable column) 1.86 bits, RGP 83%; column 28 (ykfI, a fork column) 1.79 bits, RGP 85%; column 27 ("LEM-3-like GIY-YIG domain-containing pr…", a variable column) 1.79 bits, RGP 86%. Every column has most of its calls in an RGP.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 3 spine columns: named 95%, 0.41 bits on average; the 77 fork and variable columns: named 79%, 1.08 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 29, is a variable column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all S, RGP 100%. Genes: betA. named 99%; 0.21 bits.
[S2] 2. column 1 fork: share 82%, all S, RGP 100%. named 77%; 1.26 bits.
